source.title: rbh Mpls Bog birds.wav
source.author: RHumphries
source.prepare: python scripts/sound-clean.py <file> bog_matched.wav --match <the mod's old ambient/outside/bog.ogg> 0.54, then --source bog_matched.wav
source.notes: 48 kHz 24-bit stereo, 180 s. The old loop was 49 s of it from 0.5 s at 48 kHz (629 kB), its tone reshaped: matched again with --match, the loop 87 s at 32 kHz for about the same size. Ends at 88 s so the crossfade lies in a calm stretch (a loud bird call at 92.8-95.5 s).
